title: Quick Japanese Chicken Fritters
description: Crispy, protein-packed chicken fritters with fresh basil and a hint of sweet soy glaze.
instructions: Pound the chicken into thin strips.
Toss the chicken with chopped basil, salt, pepper, and a splash of soy sauce.
Whisk the egg in a shallow bowl; in another bowl combine flour, corn starch, dashi powder, mirin, and sugar.
Dip each chicken strip first in the egg, then coat evenly with the flour mixture.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 180°C and test with a small breadcrumb piece; it should bubble immediately.
Fry the coated strips in batches for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with a drizzle of extra soy sauce or a squeeze of lemon.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
